# Family — Style Reference

> Oat paper, felt-tip confetti, and one black lacquer pill. A tightly tracked custom grotesk sits on white and linen tiles ruled by stone hairlines, while saturated color lives only in drawn characters and blue labels.

**Theme:** light

Values are measured from the live site and normalized; names, roles and recommendations are interpretation. Font lists are independent, not paired by position. Example prompts describe reconstructions, not the site's source code.

Family uses a sticker-book-on-stone product language: a warm, nearly achromatic interface that hands every saturated hue to its drawings. The canvas is #ffffff. Bento tiles and the mid-page feature band sit on #fbfaf9, secondary pills on #f6f4ef, and tile edges are a 1px inset ring of #f2f0ed instead of a border. The system's own chromatic budget is two text-only label hues, #1a88f8 and an amber #ca8a04, used for eyebrows and showcase captions. Confetti characters, phone mockups and avatar circles carry every louder color as content. Type runs in two tiers. Inter at 400 to 600 fills 13px to 23px in near-1px steps with negative tracking at every size. The custom Family grotesk at weight 500 then leaps to 44px and 68px at -1.36px, so size and face carry hierarchy rather than weight. Shapes pair 10px tiles with 32px pills. Elevation comes from rings and tonal shifts, and real shadow is rationed to floating menus. The site reads as a toy chest shelved in a quiet gallery rather than a trading terminal.

## Tokens — Typography

### Family — Custom display grotesk at weight 500 that carries every headline · `--font-family`

- **Substitute:** Inter Display at 600, Geist at 600, Plus Jakarta Sans at 600. Family's nominal 500 draws heavier than a typical medium, and the 68px hero strokes read like a semibold. Matching its visual weight therefore means stepping the substitutes up one notch. Do not use them at 700, which turns the voice shouty.
- **Weights:** 500
- **Sizes:** 44px, 68px
- **Line height:** 1.09, 1.1
- **Letter spacing:** -1.35px at 44px, -1.36px at 68px
- **Role:** A single weight across both sizes is the signature move. The face never gets bolder as it grows, only larger and tighter, so headlines are massive and calm. The 68/44 ratio is 1.545, wider than a Perfect Fourth (1.333). The display tier is a deliberate cliff rather than a gentle continuation of the body scale. The absolute tracking barely changes between sizes, so the 44px heading runs tighter in em terms (-0.031em) than the 68px hero (-0.02em). This anti-convention choice keeps section heads dense and the hero more open.

### Inter — The interface and reading voice for everything under 24px · `--font-inter`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 400 (the same face, free on Google Fonts, an exact match), Geist at 400, IBM Plex Sans at 400. Inter renders true to its nominal weight. Plex draws slightly narrower, so hold it at 400 and do not drop it to 300.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 19px, 23px
- **Line height:** 1.58, 1.38, 1.43, 1.47, 1.53, 1.42, 1.09
- **Letter spacing:** -0.01px at 12px, -0.13px at 13px, -0.09px at 14px, -0.13px at 15px, -0.22px at 17px, -0.3px at 19px, -0.44px at 23px
- **OpenType features:** none detected
- **Role:** Inter is the workhorse, with 209 sampled uses against 22 for the display face. The text steps advance by roughly 1px (13, 14, 15, 17, 19), a ratio near 1.07 that is far finer than the Minor Third (1.2) most systems use. Hierarchy below the headline is therefore carried by weight (400 body, 600 tile titles) and color (graphite versus pewter), not by size jumps. Negative tracking at every size, scaled from -0.01px to -0.44px, matches the tight grain of the display face so the two families read as one hand.

### LFE Sans — The in-app typeface rendered inside product mockups · `--font-lfe-sans`

- **Substitute:** Inter at 500, Geist at 500, Figtree at 500. LFE Sans draws true to its nominal weight, and its 500 sits slightly rounder than Inter's, which Figtree tracks closely.
- **Weights:** 400, 500, 600
- **Sizes:** 12px, 13px, 14px, 15px, 16px, 17px, 19px, 20px
- **Line height:** normal (1.2)
- **Letter spacing:** -0.15px at 14px, -0.24px at 15px, -0.32px at 16px, -0.32px at 17px, -0.494px at 19px, -0.4px at 20px, 0px at 12px and 13px
- **Role:** This face appears only inside the tile vignettes: the "Back Up Now" pill, the transaction-status list and the speed selector. It is mockup-internal, not page chrome. Its presence means the marketing site quotes the app's actual typography rather than re-rendering screens in Inter, a fidelity choice most fintech landing pages skip. Do not use it for marketing copy outside a mockup frame.

### Type Scale

| Role | Family | Weight | Size | Line Height | Letter Spacing | Token |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| small | Inter | 400 | 13px | 1.38 | -0.13px | `--text-small` |
| caption | Inter | 400 | 14px | 1.43 | -0.09px | `--text-caption` |
| body-sm | Inter | 400 | 15px | 1.47 | -0.13px | `--text-body-sm` |
| body | Inter | 400 | 17px | 1.53 | -0.22px | `--text-body` |
| body-lg | Inter | 400 | 19px | 1.42 | -0.3px | `--text-body-lg` |
| subheading | Inter | 500 | 23px | 1.09 | -0.44px | `--text-subheading` |
| heading | Family | 500 | 44px | 1.09 | -1.35px | `--text-heading` |
| display | Family | 500 | 68px | 1.1 | -1.36px | `--text-display` |

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep the interface chrome achromatic on #ffffff, #fbfaf9, #f6f4ef and #171717. Saturation belongs to illustration and mockups, and that separation is the identity.
- Set body copy in Inter 400 at 17px/1.53 with -0.22px tracking in #474645. The warm graphite is what makes the page read as paper.
- Set every headline in Family at weight 500, 68px with -1.36px tracking for the hero and 44px with -1.35px for section heads. The page scales headlines up without bolding them.
- Build buttons as 32px-radius pills, 32px tall in the nav and 48px in the hero, pairing #171717 primary with #f6f4ef secondary. The pill shape is the one place the system goes fully round.
- Edge every content tile with `inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed` on #fbfaf9 at a 10px radius. The ring defines the tile without adding visual weight.
- Restrict #1a88f8 and #ca8a04 to eyebrows, captions and line icons at Inter 14px weight 600. Label hues mark chapters, and the rule against using them as fills is non-negotiable.
- Separate sections by 92px inside a 1072px container, with a 32px gutter between tiles. Generous section rhythm lets dense 1px-step text breathe.

### Don't
- Don't fill a button, tile or nav with #f97316, #ff3e00 or any other illustration hue. The system outsources saturation to drawings, and pulling one onto chrome turns a sticker book into a promo flyer.
- Don't set body text in #000000 or a cool #6b7280 grey (not a system token). Both break the warm stone cast that #474645 and #848281 establish.
- Don't border tiles with a solid 1px #e5e5e5 line (not a system token). A neutral grey border is the convention this system replaces with a #f2f0ed inset ring.
- Don't bump Family headlines to 700 for emphasis. Weight 500 at 68px is the voice, and heavier strokes turn the calm hero into a banner ad.
- Don't leave Inter at 0px tracking. Every measured size runs negative (-0.09px at 14px, -0.22px at 17px), and default spacing makes text look loose beside the tight display face.
- Don't give buttons the 10px tile radius or square 4px corners. Buttons are 32px pills, and mixing shapes erases the line between "content" and "action".
- Don't put the 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) shadow on feature tiles. It is reserved for floating menus, and resting content should never cast a shadow in this system.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- tile surface: #fbfaf9 (Linen Tile)
- secondary fill: #f6f4ef (Sand Pill)
- heading text: #121212 (Jet Ink)
- body text: #474645 (Graphite Body)
- hairline: #f2f0ed (Quartz Hairline)
- label accent: #1a88f8 (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #171717 (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts and bars default to #474645 strokes on #f2f0ed tracks. A single highlighted series may use #1a88f8 as a solid fill, and any additional series use #1a88f8 at 20% opacity. Illustration hues such as #f97316 stay out of data, so no figure outshouts the onyx CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Primary Action Button: Build an anchor styled as a pill with background #171717, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 32px, height 48px and padding 0 24px. Set the label in Inter at 17px, weight 500, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.22px. Place a 17px white Apple glyph before the label with an 8px gap. No shadow. Pair it on the same row, 12px apart, with a secondary pill: background #f6f4ef, text #121212, radius 32px, height 48px, padding 0 20px, same type, with a 14px filled play triangle in #121212 before "Watch the Video". For the compact nav variant use height 32px, padding 0 14px and Inter 15px weight 500 at -0.09px tracking.

2. Navigation Bar: Create a 94px-tall header on #ffffff with position relative (not sticky) and no border or shadow, containing a 1072px-max container with 24px side padding. Left: an 18px-tall wordmark, then three triggers 8px apart, each Inter 15px weight 500 in #282624 with padding 10px, radius 6px and a 10px chevron after the label. Right: a 32px "Log In" pill (#f6f4ef, #121212, radius 32px, padding 0 14px) and a 32px "Get Started" pill (#171717, #ffffff, radius 32px, padding 0 14px), 8px apart, both Inter 15px weight 500. Hovering a trigger opens a #ffffff panel with an 8px radius, shadow 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) and 8px padding, whose rows are Inter 15px weight 600 #121212 with padding 8px 12px and radius 6px, captions in Inter 14px weight 400 #848281.

3. Feature Tile (bento): Build a three-column grid inside 1072px with a 32px gap. Each tile has background #fbfaf9, border-radius 10px, box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed, padding 24px and no drop shadow. The upper area holds a centered vignette, for example a pill reading "Back Up Now". Beneath it put a title in Inter 15px weight 600 #121212 with -0.13px tracking, then 4px of space, then a description in Inter 15px/22px weight 400 #848281. The left column tile spans two rows and holds a #171717 list mockup cropped at the tile edge.

4. Hero Section: Center a column with max-width 1072px and 92px top padding. Set the headline "Your favorite crypto wallet." in Family (fallback Inter Display 600) at 68px, weight 500, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -1.36px, color #121212, breaking onto two lines, with 16px of space below. Add two lines of Inter 17px/26px weight 400 #474645 at -0.22px. Then 32px of space and the onyx and sand 48px pill pair. Place flat illustration clusters (decorative colors, not system tokens) absolutely positioned on the left and right, outside the text column. The background stays #ffffff with no gradient.

The type is Inter at 15px weight 500 with -0.09px tracking, rising to 17px weight 500 at -0.22px in the hero, where a leading Apple glyph sits at the same size. There is no shadow. It is the only near-black fill on a white page, so it reads as the one decision rather than one option among several.

### Pill Button — Sand (Secondary)
**Role:** Alternate action beside the primary

An oat-paper capsule. The background is #f6f4ef with #121212 text, no border and a radius of 32px. It uses padding 0 14px at 32px height for "Log In" and 0 20px at 48px height for "Watch the Video", which carries a filled play triangle. The type is Inter at 15px or 17px weight 500, with no shadow. The fill is tonal rather than outlined, a deliberately anti-convention answer to the ghost-border secondary most SaaS sites ship. It sits one step off the canvas, so it stays visibly tappable without competing with the onyx pill.

### Navigation Bar — Transparent Top Band
**Role:** Brand mark, product menus, account actions

An unpinned, transparent masthead. It is a 94px band on #ffffff with relative positioning, so it scrolls away with the hero. The wordmark and three triggers (Developers, Resources, X) sit left inside the 1072px container. The sand "Log In" and onyx "Get Started" pills sit right with an 8px gap. Triggers use Inter at 15px weight 500 in #282624, padding 10px, radius 6px, a 6px chevron gap and no shadow. Refusing both stickiness and a fill lets the illustration own the first fold.

### Dropdown Menu — Floating Panel
**Role:** Product and resource sub-navigation

The one truly shadowed surface. The panel is #ffffff with an 8px radius and the lg shadow `0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`. Link rows are Inter at 15px weight 600 in #121212 with 8px 12px padding and a 6px radius. Product rows add a 32px outlined icon tile and a caption line in Inter 14px weight 400 at #848281. The rows stack with a 4px gap. Real shadow is reserved for things that actually float over the page, so this panel is the system's reference for "above".

### Feature Tile — Linen (Main Content Card)
**Role:** Bento cell pairing vignette and claim

A linen bento cell. The background is #fbfaf9 with no border and an inset ring `inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed`. The radius is 10px and the padding 24px. A mockup vignette fills the upper portion, followed by a title in Inter 15px weight 600 #121212 and a two-line description in Inter 15px/22px weight 400 at #848281. There is no drop shadow. This is the workhorse card: it stays quiet so the miniature UI inside it can speak, and the 32px gutter between tiles does the separating.

### Phone Showcase Tile — Cropped Device
**Role:** Screen-level product proof

A device seen through a window. A #fbfaf9 tile with a 10px radius and the #f2f0ed inset ring holds a dark iPhone mockup (frame #171717, screen corners 40px). The tile's bottom edge crops the phone flush. Below the tile sits a centered caption: a 16px glyph plus an Inter 15px weight 500 label tinted by action. Send uses #1a88f8, Receive uses a green #00ca48 (mockup-internal, not a system token) and Swap uses #848281. The crop implies the app continues past the frame, which is more honest than floating a full device under a drop shadow.

### Feature Band — Eyebrow and Paragraph Grid
**Role:** Dense capability claims block

A full-bleed tonal stripe. The band is #fbfaf9 from edge to edge with 92px vertical padding and a two-column grid inside 1072px. Each item is an eyebrow in Inter 14px weight 600 #1a88f8 above a paragraph in Inter 17px/26px weight 400 #474645 at -0.22px tracking, with an 8px eyebrow gap and 48px between rows. This is the only place the canvas changes tone at section scale, so it groups the technical claims into one readable slab.

### Split Feature — Mockup and Copy
**Role:** Chapter-level storytelling row

A two-column narrative row. On the left is a #fbfaf9 tile (10px radius) holding a phone. On the right, in order: an amber eyebrow in Inter 14px weight 600 #ca8a04; a Family 44px weight 500 heading at -1.35px; Inter 19px/27px body in #474645; a two-column icon list of media types in #ca8a04 at Inter 15px weight 500 with 20px row spacing. The per-section eyebrow hue lets a long page change chapters without introducing a new fill color.

### Video Demo Card
**Role:** Inline link to a product demo

A thumbnail-led inline link. It has a transparent background, a 12px radius, padding 12px 32px 12px 12px and 68px height. At rest the ring is measured at 0px spread (`inset 0 0 0 0 #f2f0ed`), and the 1px hairline grows in as the interactive state. An 8px-radius thumbnail leads, followed by a title in Inter 14px weight 600 #121212 and a "Watch the demo" line in Inter 13px weight 400 #848281. The animated ring is the affordance, so no fill or shadow is needed.

### Avatar Carousel — Circle Marquee
**Role:** Personality proof inside "Fun"

A rolling sticker strip. Circles with a 72px radius, fully round at their size, carry saturated fills. #f97316 is the one fill the extraction caught; the others are illustration-internal. They scroll horizontally inside the linen tile with an 8px gap, and the edge neighbors are clipped by the tile's 10px corners. This is the system outlier: it is the only interface-like element in hot color. It is allowed because it depicts delight rather than performing interaction.

### Hero Illustration Cluster
**Role:** Brand personality and first-fold color

Decorative confetti wings. Two flat-vector clusters flank the centered 68px headline, one on each side of the 1072px container. They contain characters with dot eyes, coins, stars, hearts and clouds, with no container, radius or shadow. The palette includes #ff3e00 red-orange and #00ca48 green (both decorative, not system tokens) alongside sky blues and golds. The entire page's saturation lives here, which is what allows every button and tile to stay greyscale.

### Hairline Section Divider
**Role:** Separator between content chapters

A single stone rule. It is a 1px line in #f2f0ed (estimated) spanning the full 1072px container, with 48px of space above and 80px below before the next heading. The divider uses the same ink as the tile ring, so separators and edges belong to one material. It appears where two white-canvas sections meet and no tonal band is available to split them.

### Footer — Link Columns
**Role:** Secondary navigation and sign-off

A quiet link register. It is transparent on #ffffff with padding 68px 0 96px inside 1072px. Column heads (Developers, Resources) are set in Inter 15px weight 500 #474645, and links are Inter 16px weight 400 in #a7a7a7 with a 12px row gap. There are no tiles, rules or social badges beyond a plain "Follow Family" link. The page ends in the lightest ink the system owns, a fade-out rather than the dark footer slab most fintech sites use.

## Do's and Don'ts

### Do
- Keep the interface chrome achromatic on #ffffff, #fbfaf9, #f6f4ef and #171717. Saturation belongs to illustration and mockups, and that separation is the identity.
- Set body copy in Inter 400 at 17px/1.53 with -0.22px tracking in #474645. The warm graphite is what makes the page read as paper.
- Set every headline in Family at weight 500, 68px with -1.36px tracking for the hero and 44px with -1.35px for section heads. The page scales headlines up without bolding them.
- Build buttons as 32px-radius pills, 32px tall in the nav and 48px in the hero, pairing #171717 primary with #f6f4ef secondary. The pill shape is the one place the system goes fully round.
- Edge every content tile with `inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed` on #fbfaf9 at a 10px radius. The ring defines the tile without adding visual weight.
- Restrict #1a88f8 and #ca8a04 to eyebrows, captions and line icons at Inter 14px weight 600. Label hues mark chapters, and the rule against using them as fills is non-negotiable.
- Separate sections by 92px inside a 1072px container, with a 32px gutter between tiles. Generous section rhythm lets dense 1px-step text breathe.

### Don't
- Don't fill a button, tile or nav with #f97316, #ff3e00 or any other illustration hue. The system outsources saturation to drawings, and pulling one onto chrome turns a sticker book into a promo flyer.
- Don't set body text in #000000 or a cool #6b7280 grey (not a system token). Both break the warm stone cast that #474645 and #848281 establish.
- Don't border tiles with a solid 1px #e5e5e5 line (not a system token). A neutral grey border is the convention this system replaces with a #f2f0ed inset ring.
- Don't bump Family headlines to 700 for emphasis. Weight 500 at 68px is the voice, and heavier strokes turn the calm hero into a banner ad.
- Don't leave Inter at 0px tracking. Every measured size runs negative (-0.09px at 14px, -0.22px at 17px), and default spacing makes text look loose beside the tight display face.
- Don't give buttons the 10px tile radius or square 4px corners. Buttons are 32px pills, and mixing shapes erases the line between "content" and "action".
- Don't put the 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) shadow on feature tiles. It is reserved for floating menus, and resting content should never cast a shadow in this system.

## Elevation

- **Content tiles (30 elements):** `inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed`
- **Demo cards at rest:** `inset 0 0 0 0 #f2f0ed`
- **Small framed UI fragments inside mockups:** `0 0 0 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)`
- **Mockup cards that sit inside tiles:** `0 1px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 0 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05)`
- **Dropdown menu panels:** `0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`
- **Highlighted vignette objects (the backup pill glow):** `0 0 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15)`

## Imagery

Family uses no photography. Imagery splits into two registers. The first is flat vector illustration: blobby characters with dot eyes, coins, stars, hearts, clouds and Ethereum diamonds, scattered as confetti around the hero in full saturation. The second is product mockups: dark iPhone frames in #171717 with 40px screen corners, cropped flush by #fbfaf9 tiles at a 10px radius with only the #f2f0ed inset ring and no drop shadow. Miniature UI vignettes inside the bento tiles reuse the app's LFE Sans typeface. Interface icons are 1.5px-stroke line glyphs (estimated) tinted #ca8a04 or #1a88f8, while mockup icons are filled circles. There are no gradients, orbs or glows as system tokens. The illustration palette, including #ff3e00 and #00ca48, is decorative only. The narrative is that crypto, usually cold and numeric, becomes a friendly cast of characters living inside a calm, paper-white app.

## Layout

Content sits in a 1072px container with 24px side padding, giving a 1024px measure, and sections advance at a 92px rhythm. The hero centers a two-line 68px headline, two lines of 17px subcopy and a pair of 48px pills, flanked by illustration clusters that bleed toward the viewport edges. Below it, a centered 44px heading introduces a three-column bento of linen tiles with a 32px gutter. A hairline divider leads into a left-aligned heading over a three-column phone showcase. A full-bleed #fbfaf9 band then holds a two-column eyebrow grid, followed by split rows (mockup left, copy right). Sections alternate white, tinted and white rather than light and dark. The nav is relative, transparent and 94px tall, with the logo and menus left and the pills right. The footer is a 68px/96px padded block of link columns. At 375px, use the 44px heading size as the display size, stack every grid to one column and drop the section gap to 48px. Overall density: comfortable.

## Agent Prompt Guide

**Quick Color Reference**
- canvas: #ffffff (Paper Canvas)
- tile surface: #fbfaf9 (Linen Tile)
- secondary fill: #f6f4ef (Sand Pill)
- heading text: #121212 (Jet Ink)
- body text: #474645 (Graphite Body)
- hairline: #f2f0ed (Quartz Hairline)
- label accent: #1a88f8 (Signal Blue)
- primary action: #171717 (filled action)

**Color in Data**
Charts and bars default to #474645 strokes on #f2f0ed tracks. A single highlighted series may use #1a88f8 as a solid fill, and any additional series use #1a88f8 at 20% opacity. Illustration hues such as #f97316 stay out of data, so no figure outshouts the onyx CTA.

**Example Component Prompts**

1. Primary Action Button: Build an anchor styled as a pill with background #171717, text #ffffff, no border, border-radius 32px, height 48px and padding 0 24px. Set the label in Inter at 17px, weight 500, line-height 1, letter-spacing -0.22px. Place a 17px white Apple glyph before the label with an 8px gap. No shadow. Pair it on the same row, 12px apart, with a secondary pill: background #f6f4ef, text #121212, radius 32px, height 48px, padding 0 20px, same type, with a 14px filled play triangle in #121212 before "Watch the Video". For the compact nav variant use height 32px, padding 0 14px and Inter 15px weight 500 at -0.09px tracking.

2. Navigation Bar: Create a 94px-tall header on #ffffff with position relative (not sticky) and no border or shadow, containing a 1072px-max container with 24px side padding. Left: an 18px-tall wordmark, then three triggers 8px apart, each Inter 15px weight 500 in #282624 with padding 10px, radius 6px and a 10px chevron after the label. Right: a 32px "Log In" pill (#f6f4ef, #121212, radius 32px, padding 0 14px) and a 32px "Get Started" pill (#171717, #ffffff, radius 32px, padding 0 14px), 8px apart, both Inter 15px weight 500. Hovering a trigger opens a #ffffff panel with an 8px radius, shadow 0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) and 8px padding, whose rows are Inter 15px weight 600 #121212 with padding 8px 12px and radius 6px, captions in Inter 14px weight 400 #848281.

3. Feature Tile (bento): Build a three-column grid inside 1072px with a 32px gap. Each tile has background #fbfaf9, border-radius 10px, box-shadow inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed, padding 24px and no drop shadow. The upper area holds a centered vignette, for example a pill reading "Back Up Now". Beneath it put a title in Inter 15px weight 600 #121212 with -0.13px tracking, then 4px of space, then a description in Inter 15px/22px weight 400 #848281. The left column tile spans two rows and holds a #171717 list mockup cropped at the tile edge.

4. Hero Section: Center a column with max-width 1072px and 92px top padding. Set the headline "Your favorite crypto wallet." in Family (fallback Inter Display 600) at 68px, weight 500, line-height 1.1, letter-spacing -1.36px, color #121212, breaking onto two lines, with 16px of space below. Add two lines of Inter 17px/26px weight 400 #474645 at -0.22px. Then 32px of space and the onyx and sand 48px pill pair. Place flat illustration clusters (decorative colors, not system tokens) absolutely positioned on the left and right, outside the text column. The background stays #ffffff with no gradient.

## Chromatic Outsourcing

The defining discipline is that the interface owns no saturated fill: every loud color is delegated to drawings and mockups. Buttons are #171717 or #f6f4ef, tiles are #fbfaf9, and text runs from #121212 to #a7a7a7. The only hues the system itself applies, #1a88f8 and #ca8a04, appear as text and line icons. This breaks the moment someone tints a CTA blue or fills a banner with the orange from the avatar strip, because the chrome then competes with the characters and the page loses its toy-chest-in-a-gallery tension. To extend the system, add new hues only inside illustration or mockup layers. A new chapter may introduce one new eyebrow hue at Inter 14px weight 600. It may not introduce a new fill.

## Two-Tier Type

Family's type is two separate instruments. Inter covers 13px to 23px in steps of roughly 1px, while Family weight 500 jumps straight to 44px and 68px with nothing in between except one 23px Inter subheading. Conventional modular scales (1.25 or 1.333) would fill the gap with 28px and 36px headings. This system refuses those steps, so a heading is unmistakably a heading and everything else is reading text. The structure breaks when an intermediate 32px Family heading appears, or when Inter is pushed above 23px to fake a headline. To extend it, add text sizes only within Inter's 1px-step band and add display sizes only above 44px, keeping weight 500 and tracking at -1.35px or tighter.

## Ring Before Shadow

Elevation here is a sequence of rings and tones. Resting tiles get `inset 0 0 0 1px #f2f0ed`, demo cards animate that ring from 0px to 1px, and only menus that physically overlap content receive `0 3px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1)`. The common Material-style habit of shadowing every card would break this, as would a darker hairline such as #e5e5e5 (not a system token). Either one makes the linen tiles feel stacked instead of printed. To extend the system, give new resting containers the subtle ring and a surface one step up the stack. Reserve md through xl shadows for overlays, popovers and toasts that sit above scrolling content.

## Similar Brands

- **Rainbow** — Another Ethereum wallet whose marketing leans on saturated, character-like illustration. Rainbow lets gradients into buttons and backgrounds, whereas Family keeps all chrome greyscale.
- **Phantom** — A consumer crypto wallet with rounded, friendly product mockups. Phantom puts its brand violet on primary CTAs, while Family's primary action is #171717.
- **The Browser Company (Arc)** — Shares the warm off-white surfaces, playful drawn assets and a tightly tracked custom display grotesk at medium weight.
- **Things by Cultured Code** — Shares the tonal-tile product presentation, cropped device mockups and hairline-only separation, without the confetti layer.
- **Headspace** — Shares the move of giving all emotional color to illustrated characters while interface type stays restrained. Headspace allows a brand orange on buttons, which Family declines.
